title: Innovative Multitarget Organoselenium Hybrids With Apoptotic and Anti-Inflammatory Properties Acting as JAK1/STAT3 Suppressors.
authors: Shaaban, Saad; Alabdali, Aya Yaseen Mahmood; Mousa, Mai H A; Ba-Ghazal, Hussein; Al-Faiyz, Yasair S; Elghamry, Ibrahim; Althikrallah, Hanan A; Khatib, Arwa Omar Al; Alaasar, Mohamed; Al-Karmalawy, Ahmed A
one_liner_zh: 该文为有机硒化合物的合成与抗癌/抗炎活性研究，涉及JAK1/STAT3蛋白靶点，但无蛋白质-DNA互作体系、无结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Herein, we report the design, synthesis, and characterization of novel organoselenium (OSe) hybrids (5-19) via modifications of the lead, N-(4-selaneylphenyl)-2-selaneylacetamide. The OSe-based thiazol 9 showed the highest growth inhibition % (GI%) of 64.72% relative to the positive reference doxorubicin (DOX), with a GI% of 79.5%. Furthermore, the novel OSe derivatives showed low GI% values compared to the normal cell lines employed, demonstrating their selectivity. The OSe tethered N-chloroacetamide 5 and Schiff base 19 showed a cytotoxic effect with an IC(50) of (25.07 and 11.61 microM), respectively, against the A549 tumor cell line and IC(50) of (34.22 and 20.12 microM), respectively, against the HELA cancer cell line. Enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay to study the JAK1 and the STAT3 inhibitory potentials of OSe compounds 5 and 19 in the A549 cancer cells both showed promising inhibitory activities with IC(50) values of 25.07 and 11.61 microM, respectively. Protein expression analysis on the A549 cancer cell line on OSe compounds 5 and 19 showed upregulation of P53, BAX, and Caspases 3, 6, 8, and 9 as apoptotic proteins. However, both candidates expressed downregulation of the antiapoptotic proteins (BCL2, MMP2, and MMP9). Moreover, OSe compounds 5 and 19 described the downregulation of the examined inflammatory proteins: COX2, IL-6, and IL-1beta. In addition, OSe compound 19 showed potential cell cycle arrest at the G0, S, and G2-M layers, with an increase in cellular levels. Finally, molecular docking studies of OSe compound 19 showed the most promising inhibitory potential toward the JAK1 and STAT3 target receptors, with binding scores and interactions exceeding that of the cocrystallized inhibitor of JAK1.
abstract_zh: 在此，我们报告了通过对先导化合物N-(4-硒苯基)-2-硒乙酰胺进行修饰，设计、合成并表征新型有机硒 (organoselenium, OSe) 杂合体（5-19）的过程。基于OSe的噻唑化合物9显示出最高的生长抑制率（GI%），为64.72%，相对于阳性参照多柔比星 (doxorubicin, DOX) 的GI%为79.5%。此外，新型OSe衍生物对所采用的正常细胞系显示出较低的GI%值，表明其具有选择性。OSe连接的N-氯乙酰胺化合物5和席夫碱化合物19对A549肿瘤细胞系表现出细胞毒性效应，IC(50)分别为25.07和11.61微摩尔，对HELA癌细胞系的IC(50)分别为34.22和20.12微摩尔。通过酶联免疫吸附试验研究OSe化合物5和19在A549癌细胞中对JAK1和STAT3的抑制潜力，两者均显示出有前景的抑制活性，IC(50)值分别为25.07和11.61微摩尔。对A549癌细胞系中OSe化合物5和19的蛋白表达分析显示，凋亡蛋白P53、BAX以及Caspases 3、6、8和9上调。然而，这两个候选物均表现出抗凋亡蛋白（BCL2、MMP2和MMP9）的下调。此外，OSe化合物5和19描述了所检测炎症蛋白COX2、IL-6和IL-1β的下调。另外，OSe化合物19在G0、S和G2-M期显示出潜在的细胞周期阻滞，并伴随细胞水平增加。最后，OSe化合物19的分子对接研究显示，其对JAK1和STAT3靶受体具有最有前景的抑制潜力，结合分数和相互作用超过JAK1共结晶抑制剂。
